body.label: Target
body.html: One detected enemy within 3 units beside an unattended obstacle.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the enemy is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn; you or a willing ally within 2 units may move 1 unit toward the obstacle.

surges.html: On a hit, impose -1 Fortitude against the next melee attack targeting iter until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Gambit
rider.html: When the enemy attacks anyone other than you before your next turn, it becomes Exposed and loses 1 remaining unit of Movement that turn.
